scientific_change: Common deployment leg Kp 500 -> 400 in both engines; no policy or optimizer update.
hypothesis: A modest stiffness perturbation with a frozen actor can distinguish closed-loop controller effects from continued-PPO optimization effects. No prediction of successful transfer is made.
motivation: Trial006's halved stiffness plus continued learning worsened drift timing, wheel unloading, path, height and stopping. This experiment returns to trial004 rather than continuing either failed trial005 or trial006 actor.

controller_change.tradeoff: Linear free-mode frequency scales by sqrt(0.8), damping ratio by 1/sqrt(0.8), and same-load static holding error by 1.25; these are not nonlinear contact or trajectory predictions.

policy.selection: One predesignated actor and one gain value; no gain sweep or best-of-rollout selection.

activation_prerequisites: Publish complete failed trial006 evidence and verify GitHub branch.
Full regression and strict forged-metadata/stale-gain tests pass; historical publisher artifacts remain byte-identical.
Original training manifest, checkpoint, profile, motion, asset and controller contract hashes verify without alteration.
Actual runtime gain readback verifies deployment Kp400/Kd10 before policy use.
Fresh idle GPU/UUID guard and unmasked native device audit; no other users' jobs modified.

evaluation.conditions: Nominal motors, reference frame zero and its original initial velocity; no added lateral velocity or hidden root writes.
evaluation.recording: Both engines record the complete first episode at actual 200 Hz; ordinary policy clock remains 50 Hz.
evaluation.same_actor: Verify checkpoint/export actor and normalizer tensors, recorded-action replay, same actor bytes and MuJoCo reconstructed observations.
evaluation.acceptance: At least 0.20 s uninterrupted forward-moving drift with speed >= 0.4 m/s, abs(sideslip) >= 8 deg, both actual bearing ground contacts and mean lateral patch slip >= 0.04 m/s. All original tracking, support, nonwheel-impact, full-duration and stable-exit checks must also pass.
evaluation.source_fidelity: Separate unchanged source-window overlap and sign diagnostic; no phase shifting and no assertion that these are implemented as assessor gates.
evaluation.format: Captured car -> TRON1 kinematic reference -> Isaac frozen policy -> MuJoCo same frozen policy; retain complete four-panel evidence even on failure.
evaluation.interpretation: Any result concerns this single zero-shot controller setting, not a policy trained at Kp400, hardware readiness or statistical robustness.

resources.mode: One owned app at a time on authorized remote compute, with no CUDA mask/remapping.
